reasons.claim: Aban narrates from the Imam, who answers and is the last link.
reasons.quote: رَوَى أَبَانُ بْنُ تَغْلِبَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ

reasons.claim: Yahya and Abd al-Rahman are co-transmitters meeting at Sufyan.
reasons.quote: وعبد الرحمن بن مهدي، قالا حدثنا سفيان

reasons.claim: The remark on Abu Hudhayfa is a description, and Aisha is the last link.
reasons.quote: وكان، من أصحاب ابن مسعود عن عائشة

reasons.claim: The chain runs to Jabir; the Ansari man belongs to the story.
reasons.quote: عن أبي الزبير، عن جابر، أن رجلا، من الأنصار

reasons.claim: Talha, Ja'far, his father, then Ali who speaks the saying as last link.
reasons.quote: عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ قَالَ عَلِيٌّ

reasons.claim: «في حديثه» is not a name; the single route runs from Hannad to Ibn Abbas.
reasons.quote: هناد بن السري، في حديثه عن أبي معاوية

reasons.claim: The report is a bare saying with no transmitter.
Maymuna is named as the source of the account and is the last link.
reasons.quote: أخبرتني خالتي، ميمونة بنت الحارث قالت

reasons.claim: Ibn Qudama and Mu'ammal are co-transmitters from Isma'il.
reasons.quote: حدثنا محمد بن قدامة، ومؤمل بن هشام

reasons.claim: The chain ends at the grandfather; the brother or uncle only acts in the story.
reasons.quote: عن أبيه، عن جده، - قال ابن قدامة - إن أخاه أو عمه

reviews.question: al-Faqih's statement of the compiler's routes («طرق») to a source, with no saying

reasons.claim: The first mention of al-Farra names the source the route reaches, not a link.
reasons.quote: و ما كان فيه عن أبي عبد اللّه الفرّاء فقد رويته

reasons.claim: The route runs from the compiler's father to al-Farra as the readers wrote it; this is right if the route statement is stored, and only storage changes if it is not.
reasons.quote: عن أبي- رضي اللّه عنه- عن سعد بن عبد اللّه

reviews.uncertainty_note: The structure is clear, but whether a route statement with no saying is stored as a chain has not been ruled.

reasons.claim: al-Ala' from al-Halabi, who asks the Imam; the Imam answers and is the last link.
reasons.quote: عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ اَلْحَلَبِيِّ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ
